in_marathi.name: Sharushmita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wisdom and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharushmita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharu means 'abundance' and Smrita means 'memory'. This name signifies the goddess of wisdom and prosperity, who is believed to bestow wealth, happiness and success in life. It is also a name of Saraswati, the Hindu goddess of knowledge, music and arts.
